title: Check and the three ways out

card.idea: Your king is in check when an enemy piece attacks him. You are never allowed to leave him there. There are only three ways out: move the king, block the line, or take the attacker.
card.habit: In check? Move, block, or take.

explain.text: The white queen on g8 attacks the black king along the eighth rank. That is check. Black has to answer it right now. You cannot ignore a check and play somewhere else on the board.

The rook on d1 checks the king on d8. Black has all three answers here. The king can step to c7 or e7. The bishop can drop into d7 and block the line. Or the rook on h1 can simply take the rook on d1.

challenges.prompt: What is happening to the black king?
options: He is safe; the queen cannot reach him.
He is in check from the queen on h7.
He is safe; the queen is on the wrong colour of square.
challenges.reason: The queen on h7 runs down the diagonal through g6 to f5, and that is where the king stands.

hints.text: Follow every line out of h7 and see which one ends on the king.
